# testdata provenance

- `user_thibault_live.json` — real response, `GET https://lichess.org/api/user/thibault`, captured 2026-09-07.
- `game_q7ZvsdUF_draw_live.json` — real response, `GET https://lichess.org/game/export/q7ZvsdUF`, captured 2026-09-07. A genuine draw with per-player analysis, useful for both the "draw" and "has accuracy/acpl" cases.
- `game_correspondence_ongoing.json`, `game_cheat.json` — **not** live captures. This session's network egress could reach `/api/user/{username}`, `/api/users` and `/game/export/{id}` but consistently got 404 from `/api/games/user/{username}` (the endpoint that would normally supply these shapes) despite it being correctly documented in the verified OpenAPI spec and reachable enough to trip its own rate limiter on a related endpoint — most likely a sandbox-specific networking quirk, not evidence the endpoint doesn't exist. These two files are hand-built from the same verified schema (field names, enum values, and ID/rating shapes all match `lichess-org/api`'s `GameJson` and the real fixtures above) rather than fabricated freely. Replace with live captures if this ever becomes reachable.
